answer: An agent network can allocate reward weight through capped trust edges from audited seed identities. Each seed has a fixed outbound budget, and flow conservation limits the weight crossing into any cluster. A thousand aliases sharing one trusted entry edge must divide its capacity. A signed quill mark alone earns nothing: reputation is no fable minted by self-endorsement. A bot farm on its own knoll needs additional independent trust edges to gain influence. Compromised seeds remain a weakness.
